fieldNotes.facility: Niagara Bottling Middleburg plant, ~$70M facility opened 2022 near Jacksonville. Confirmed via Street View showing blue 'Niagara' branded building facade at 565 Atlantis Dr.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View up the truck driveway shows a checkpoint structure spanning the lanes mid-driveway with perimeter chain-link fencing along the property line; modern controlled entry.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A booth/canopy structure is visible across the truck driveway in Street View; consistent with a manned gatehouse, though resolution leaves moderate uncertainty.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved driveway apron (3+ lane width) at the entrance leaves ample room for an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Long trailer drop row parallel to the building along the NE face; honest overhead estimate, ~25-50 parked trailers without tractors.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock-door rhythm runs the full NE building face (~1100 ft); estimate ~65 doors, firmly 50+ band.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in overhead imagery; listed uncertain as a scale could be obscured near the gate canopy.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box (~690m N-S x ~420m E-W including retention ponds); ~56 acres.
